purpose_context: DocKitty is pinned to Astro 5 and Starlight 0.32, which blocks OpenAPI support and leaves adopters on unsupported versions. A spike with a go/no-go gate proves the upgrade first; if it holds, the same line carries the core bump, gate rebaselines, two deprecated-surface removals and 0.4.0 release prep.
purpose_tldr: Move DocKitty to Astro 7 and Starlight 0.41+ and ship it as the 0.4.0 breaking release.
